task: Does state m carried across the clean first half improve classification using only second-half scores?
data: SSC official test, all 20382 examples, matched-200 sum-pooled preprocessing
checkpoint: single frozen gdsm-mixed-best, seed 42, d=10, clean 200 plus mixed 12 epochs
primary: First 125 clean, second 125 additive iid Poisson 0.125 events/channel/frame, paired across arms
intervention: Zero both layers' stable state m once between frames 125 and 126 (one-based). Keep p, membrane, gate history and previous inputs; allow all subsequent writes, including write from p[125].
score: argmax of mean logits over frames 126-250 only
noise_rng: NumPy PCG64 seed 4917, official test order
ci: paired speaker-cluster percentile bootstrap, 10000 draws, seed 413. Keep-minus-reset in percentage points; conditional on checkpoint and noise draw.
